card.name: Words leading up to "records"
card.fires_on: Small words just before "medical records", "health records" or "history", such as "patient's", "their", "the" or "electronic". It also fires on "on" in "on record".

modes.label: Possessive before records
modes.description: A possessive or article after "in" or "to" where "medical records" comes next.
modes.example: If neither TLC nor FVC values are available in the patient<<’s>> medical records, select the Dose Delivery

modes.label: Modifier before record
modes.description: An adjective such as "electronic", "health" or "medical" right before "record(s)".
modes.example: feed their data into an<< electronic>> medical record.

modes.label: On record
modes.description: The word "on" in "warmest June on record".
modes.example: for June 2012 was the all-time warmest June<< on>> record, at 1.30

card.writes: It makes the next word more likely to be "records" or "record", including the Chinese equivalents.
